violation_type.title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Care in a natural environment (26 TAC §746.2202(5))
violation_type.short_title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Care in a natural environment
violation_type.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was learned all the toys and activities had been removed from a classroom where children were being cared for after a child with special needs was throwing them.  The child with special needs is non-verbal and communicates via iPad.  This device was removed.  During interviews, staff were unable to state what adaptations had been made to accommodate care of the child with special needs in a natural environment that was not punitive in nature.

This standard was evaluated for this investigation.  Based on the evidence, the operation doesn't have procedures or methods to care for children with special needs.
